name: Prometheus
description: Industry-standard time-series database and scraper for metrics, with its powerful query language (PromQL) and alerting rules.
compose:
services:
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/prometheus
    command:
      - --config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
      - --storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus
    restart: unless-stopped
